title: Restore drill as an automated test
goal: A test proves the newest copy restores into a working hub
acceptance: A test creates readings, runs the scheduled backup, restores the newest copy into a fresh data directory, starts the hub and reads the same rooms and readings; a corrupt or empty copy is refused with a message
The restore steps are in the README as copy-paste commands
Failing test committed first: the corrupt-copy case expects a refusal against the current restore path; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The existing backup test restores once; the drill adds the schedule and a corrupt copy. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
